explication: claude-bughunter is an authorized external bug-hunting and red-team skill bundle, with a terminal engagement runner as a distinct runtime layer. The principal workflow loads relevant guidance, scopes and maps a target, then hunts, validates, and reports findings. The README documents broad skill, enterprise-attack, OSINT, and reporting capabilities; engine excerpts show orchestration and selected calls. Several engine modules and integrations are indexed but unsampled, so their internal connections are omitted where the evidence does not establish them.
